description: Submit the address of a post about Starcovery, on a blog, Instagram, or TikTok, for review, crediting the caller's organization when it is approved. Each post is reviewed, and an approved post earns credits. Returns a tool error naming the reason when the address is no post, is on another platform than the one named, was already submitted, or passes the hourly limit. Returns the submitted claim. Needs a credential.

platform.description: blog for a web page, ig for an Instagram post, or tt for a TikTok post

postUrl.description: The address of the post about Starcovery
